headline: Mar 2026 is predicted to have the highest activity, at 2,166 applications.
detail: That is 10.3% of the forecast year's total, with a 95% prediction interval of 1,511 to 2,981.

headline: 3 high-activity month(s) predicted: Mar 2026, Apr 2026 and May 2026.
detail: These months carry 30% of forecast annual volume. Matching capacity, partner supply and reviewer bandwidth should be staged ahead of them.

headline: Total 2026 applications are forecast at 21,112, 9.8% above 2025.
detail: 2025 closed at 19,229. The forecast averages 1,759 applications per month.

headline: Lowest predicted activity falls in Jan 2026, Feb 2026.
detail: These are the natural windows for member training, partner development and process work, since delivery pressure is at its lowest.

headline: Application volume increased by 9.0% in 2025 compared with 2024.
detail: 2025 recorded 19,229 applications against 17,639 the year before, an average of 1,602 per month.

headline: Exchange activity grew at a compound annual rate of 11.5% between 2022 and 2025.
detail: Total applications rose 39% over 3 years, from 13,874 to 19,229.

headline: Peak season runs from Mar to May.
detail: 3 consecutive months sit at or above the annual average. Mar is the single strongest month at 1.29x the average.

headline: Jan is the quietest month, running at 0.74x the annual average.
detail: Mar carries 1.7x the volume of Jan. Recruitment and matching capacity should be planned around this swing rather than a flat monthly assumption.

headline: The biggest drop-off is APP to ACH, losing 85% of candidates.
detail: 56,217 of 66,253 applied candidates do not reach achieved / matched. This transition is the highest-leverage place to intervene.

headline: 3.5% of applications convert all the way to a realization.
detail: 2,344 realizations from 66,253 applications. Roughly 28 applications are needed per realization, which is the ratio to plan recruitment targets against.

headline: The top 5 Local Committees generate 43% of all applications.
detail: AIESEC in Chandigarh leads with 6,939 applications (10.5% of the MC) across 33 entities.

headline: AIESEC in M.A.H.E. is the fastest-growing large LC at +471.7% (2022->2025).
detail: It now contributes 5.7% of MC applications with an application-to-realization rate of 4.4%.

headline: oGTa is the largest programme at 32% of all applications.
detail: oGTa peaks in Aug. iGV converts best, with 9.8% of applications reaching realization versus 0.5% for oGTa.

headline: The selected model (holt_winters) achieves 87.1% accuracy in walk-forward validation (MAPE 12.9%).
detail: Mean absolute error is 198 applications per month across 24 out-of-sample origins. That is acceptable for operational planning; treat the prediction interval, not the point estimate, as the planning range.
